description.short_caption: Erythematous swelling of the left cheek with skin changes.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the left side of an elderly individual's face, focusing on the cheek. There is marked erythema, swelling, and induration of the skin, with a shiny appearance. A small area of crusting or ulceration is visible near the center of the lesion. The surrounding skin appears taut and inflamed, suggesting an acute infectious or inflammatory process.
visible_findings: erythema and swelling of the left cheek
small area of crusting or ulceration
